_help: All amounts in EUR. Months are YYYY-MM, dates YYYY-MM-DD. end_month null means still paying. Entries with 0 are ignored. See README.md.

plan._help: Read by the web cockpit (state_builder.py). default is the plan shown first. start_month is YYYY-MM of the first payment, renew_day the day of the month it renews. api_value_eur null means the API price equivalent from ccusage x usd_to_eur; a number overrides it. capacity is the plan's usage multiple (5 or 20), used for the 'would 5x have held' line.
